remarks: Welcome to this turnkey home, where true pride of ownership shines through every detail. The beautifully remodeled kitchen is a standout, featuring custom craftsmanship, premium Thermador appliances, and mountain views that provide a stunning backdrop for everyday living and entertaining. Set on a desirable corner lot, this inviting space is designed for gathering, with an island where everyone can come together. The thoughtfully designed kitchen boasts a 36-inch Thermador six-burner gas cooktop, dishwasher, double wall ovens, and a built-in microwave drawer.
